newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jiangling sees sharply higher '96 net.
newsitem.headline: Jiangling sees sharply higher '96 net.

text.p: Jiangling Motors Corp Ltd net profits this year would be sharply higher than in 1995, Xiong Zhongping, a spokesman for Jiangling, told the Hong Kong-based Securities Times in a report published on Thursday.
He said profits would be bolstered by strong results in the third quarter of this year and net profits in September hitting about nine million yuan.

Jiangling said in an interim report that, under Chinese accounting standards, audited net earnings fell to 3.39 million yuan in the first half of 1996 from 14.96 million in the year-earlier period. Sales reached 938 million yuan against 1.22 billion yuan in the January-June period of 1995.
The firm reported after-tax profits of 7.73 million yuan for 1995, down 93 percent from 117.24 million yuan in 1994.
